name: David S. Lee Fund for the Conservation of Caribbean Birds
summary: Small awards for students and early-career conservationists in the Caribbean running applied bird conservation projects that involve local groups; funds cover field travel, equipment and supplies. Applicants must be BirdsCaribbean members.

geography.label: Insular Caribbean (Greater and Lesser Antilles, including The Bahamas and Bermuda)

reporting: Awardees submit a report one year from the project start date and write a blog article about the work.

eligibility.rule: Be a paid or sponsored member of BirdsCaribbean at application
Submit the same proposal to no more than one award in a given year
Have no current BirdsCaribbean grant underway and complete previous award reporting
Student applicants are enrolled in an accredited relevant university programme
Uses no salaries, other wages or overhead fees

documents: Narrative and budget as a single PDF file
Curriculum vitae for individual applicants or short organisational summary for organisational applicants
English version, if the proposal is written in Spanish

applicant_types.quote: Applicants should be students or early career ornithologists, conservationists, or wildlife professionals

geography.quote: The grants will support projects proposed by partners working in the islands within or on the edge of the Caribbean basin (i.e., Greater Antilles and Lesser Antilles), including The Bahamas and Bermuda.

access.quote: Check our pages, blog post and social media for announcements of when the fund is open for grant applications & for details of how to apply.

amount.quote: Award Amount: Seven awards of up to $1,000.

reporting.quote: Awardees will be required to submit a report to the BirdsCaribbean's Grant Committee one year from the project start date, and a blog article about this work for our broader community.

effort.quote: Use the BirdsCaribbean Grant Proposal Submission 2027 form to submit your contact information and upload proposal files.
A committee appointed by BirdsCaribbean will review the proposals and award the grants.

eligibility.quote: Applicants must be paid or sponsored members of BirdsCaribbean at the time of application.
The same proposal cannot be submitted for more than one award in a given year.

Candidates who currently have another BirdsCaribbean Grant for Research and Conservation project underway, or who have not yet completed reporting for previous award cycles are not eligible for this Call.
A student must be enrolled in an accredited university program (advanced undergraduate level, or Masters or doctoral degrees) in ecology, biology, conservation, or related fields to be eligible.
Funds cannot be used for salaries, other wages, or overhead fees.

after_award.quote: Awardees will be required to submit a report one year from the project start date, which will be defined in the award letter, explaining how the award money was spent and the results of the project to that point.

documents.quote: Please include the narrative and budget as a single PDF file.

Curriculum vitae for individual applicants -or- short organizational summary for organizational applicants. Three letters of recommendation from persons who can attest to the applicant's effectiveness in previous bird conservation work.
We do request that applicants also include an English version as the Grants Committee will need an English translation to facilitate the revision process
